story: Verde River Greenway State Natural Area encompasses 480 acres in Arizona, USA. It is part of the Arizona State Parks system and protects a critical reach of the Verde River and its associated riparian zone between Clarkdale and the Bridgeport State Route 89A Bridge.
matters: The area protects a vital river stretch and its associated riparian zone identified by the state of Arizona as a critical natural resource.
name: Verde River Greenway State Natural Area
